sourcePreparation: Clean git archive of committed Platforms HEAD; sibling checkout clean and unmodified. Built --locked in isolated Media .cache/native-003/platforms. Installed archived package-lock.json with npm ci. No local source patches.
captureTool: xila-debug screenshot (serial tight loop; no artificial frames)

buildOptimization.reason: Unoptimized screenshot throughput was 1.8 fps; client optimization alone reached 3.1 fps. Screenshot runtime optimization raised final captures to 5.2–5.6 fps. The >=10 fps aim was not reached.

seed.verification: mise run image:native completed: released bundle publisher authentication, Xila MBR, LittleFS contents and metadata validated. Fresh disk imported this seed. No guest replacement or local guest compilation.

timing: frames.json records every successful screenshot request start (Unix and monotonic), response end (monotonic), and midpoint estimate relative to session start. No presentation timestamp is exposed; capture time is bounded by the request interval. durationSeconds is real recording-loop wall time including final response. Retiming should use measured timestamps, with held frames if needed; no invented motion.
